scope: Bounded discovery of Italian official legislation, EU free movement and third-country family residence, EEA and Swiss treaty routes, UK Withdrawal Agreement guidance, visas and consular practice, administrative procedure and access, civil-status evidence, appeals and courts, privacy, oversight and legal aid. This is not a legal-equivalence opinion or complete national inventory.
retrieval_status: 33 candidate pages converted; 0 PDFs preserved without text extraction; 1 discovery surfaces had no stable body; failures are recorded per item; no source accepted

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU-residence regulation and official guidance used as the comparison seed
comparison_seed.relationship_note: D.Lgs 30/2007 is a close functional source because Italy identifies it as implementing Directive 2004/38 for Union citizens and family members. Its Article 23 distinguishes Italian sponsors who exercised free movement from those who did not. EEA EFTA, Swiss and UK Withdrawal Agreement routes are distinct and require separate legal verification.

previous_findings_carried_forward: Denmark remains a comparison lead; earlier country findings are leads and adapter lessons, not proof that Italy has equivalent instruments or retrieval conditions.

N-Lex can be useful as an EU Member State law-portal discovery route, but the Italy connector currently reports a broken Normattiva connection; the national source must be verified at Normattiva or its responsible authority.
Czechia's keyless date-bound PDFs and Estonia, Finland, France and Germany's structured-source examples do not establish Italian API access, completeness, conversion or reuse permission.
Greece's publisher-terms issue is carried forward: review the exact Italian publisher, endpoint and intended use rather than generalizing terms across websites.
Earlier taxonomy gaps in procedure, evidence, file access, mission practice, civil status, remedies, privacy, oversight, legal aid and courts were searched separately.

search_coverage.source_class: National legislation, official publication and version discovery
search_coverage.search_outcome: Candidates found at Normattiva and Gazzetta Ufficiale. N-Lex Italy's legislation connector reports a broken database connection.
query_terms: site:normattiva.it decreto legislativo 6 febbraio 2007 n. 30 vigente
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Normattiva supports current and historical views but version-pinned URLs can be stale. N-Lex says ministerial decrees are excluded and some portal/amendment functions remain incomplete; regional law, ministerial circulars and court materials need separate official discovery.

search_coverage.source_class: EU/EEA/Swiss free movement, family residence and UK Withdrawal Agreement
search_coverage.search_outcome: National free-movement law, immigration code, official family guidance, a Swiss treaty record, EEA ratification and UK WA guidance found; exact scope and current administrative rules remain to be reconciled.
query_terms: vademecum cittadini britannici residenti Italia accordo recesso
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Article 23 now distinguishes mobile and non-mobile Italian sponsors. The D.Lgs 30 text alone does not establish EEA EFTA or Swiss coverage. UK Withdrawal Agreement guidance is dated 2021.

search_coverage.source_class: Visas, consular service and mission practice
search_coverage.search_outcome: Central MFA FAQs, Visto per Italia, a dated family-member information PDF and the dynamic mission directory were identified.
query_terms: site:esteri.it familiari cittadino UE visto Italia
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Central guidance and consular checklists are mutable; the identified family PDF is old, and no mission-by-mission visa checklist survey was performed.

search_coverage.source_class: Administrative procedure, evidence, language, time limits and access
search_coverage.search_outcome: Law 241/1990, DPR 184/2006, D.Lgs 33/2013, FOIA guidance and the Commission for Access were identified.
official_channels: Commission for Access to Administrative Documents
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Personal file access, FOIA and transparency access are different routes. Commission jurisdiction is limited to central/state administrations; local/regional access routes vary.

search_coverage.source_class: Civil status, family documents, authentication and adoption
search_coverage.search_outcome: MFA translation/legalization guidance, a mission civil-status example, administrative documentation law and Justice Ministry international-adoption guidance found.
query_terms: site:esteri.it traduzione legalizzazione documenti stranieri Italia
site:esteri.it stato civile trascrizione atti esteri
search_coverage.coverage_limit: The mission sample is local practice; comprehensive recognition rules for foreign civil-status and adoption decisions were not established. EU Regulation 2016/1191 exemptions require separate checking.

search_coverage.search_outcome: The Code of Administrative Procedure, administrative judiciary decision search, Cassation services and legal-aid routes were identified.
query_terms: site:giustizia.it patrocinio spese Stato giudizi civili amministrativi
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Jurisdiction and remedies depend on the decision type. Court-search completeness and access rules were not evaluated; legal-aid thresholds and filing instructions change.

search_coverage.source_class: Privacy, complaints, oversight and civic defenders
search_coverage.search_outcome: Garante Privacy rights and complaint routes were found. Official parliamentary material points to regional and autonomous-province civic defenders; no single national general ombudsman route was identified in this bounded search.
official_channels: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali
query_terms: site:camera.it difensore civico regionale province autonome
search_coverage.coverage_limit: The civic-defender model is fragmented by region and authority level; some regions may not have an active office. The Chamber report is a coverage lead, not a substitute for mission/region-specific first-party instructions.

search_coverage.source_class: Retrieval route, API access and reuse
search_coverage.search_outcome: Normattiva publishes official API documentation and describes legislation as open-format and freely reusable. The documented API is promising, but a direct live response was not available through the research browser.
query_terms: Normattiva API Authorization Bearer undefined registrazione
search_coverage.coverage_limit: The specification shows a 12-month maximum update interval and 7,000-act cap; examples include Bearer undefined and do not settle live authentication. Exact reuse terms, endpoint response behavior, repeated windows, conversion and source-owner review remain open.

documents.title: N-Lex Italy country information

documents.version_evidence: N-Lex states that the database includes numbered acts since 1946, excludes ministerial decrees, and has unfinished dynamic amendment links.
documents.note: Discovery lead only; not the Italian publisher and not a complete source-class catalogue.

documents.title: N-Lex Italy legislation connector
documents.verification_status: Official N-Lex page inspected; reports that the connection to Italy's Normattiva database is currently not working and directs users to Normattiva.
documents.version_evidence: Connection failure notice observed 2026-10-18.
documents.note: Do not use as a monitor endpoint; use only as a documented failed discovery route.

documents.title: Normattiva national legislation portal

documents.title: Legislative Decree 30/2007, current version

documents.note: Close functional match to the Danish seed for EU free movement, but Italy's Article 23 distinguishes mobile and non-mobile Italian sponsors; EEA, Swiss and UK routes require separate verification.

documents.title: Legislative Decree 30/2007, original Gazette version

documents.title: Legislative Decree 286/1998, Consolidated Immigration Act

documents.version_evidence: Article page showed a 2025 update; direct article URI is not a whole-act inventory.

documents.title: Presidential Decree 394/1999, implementing immigration regulation
documents.verification_status: Official Normattiva record inspected; the URL pins a consolidated edition dated 20 June 2024.

documents.note: Version mismatch is a material trap; rediscover a current version from the publisher before use.

documents.title: Normattiva Open Data project
documents.verification_status: Official project page search result states the service provides legislation in multivigenza, open formats and free reuse.
documents.version_evidence: The project is managed by IPZS under institutional supervision; the exact reuse licence and scope should be reviewed for the selected use.
documents.note: Positive first-party route evidence, not proof that every API endpoint is open or that other publishers permit reuse.
documents.retrieval_note: Public HTML response contained no sufficiently long extractable source body.

documents.title: Normattiva Open Data API specification
documents.verification_status: Official 82-page API specification inspected; describes production and pre-production endpoints and AKN, XML, PDF, EPUB, RTF, ELI URI and JSON formats.
documents.version_evidence: Revision history runs through 10 March 2026. The specification documents date-range updates with a maximum 12-month interval and 7,000 acts.
documents.note: Promising documented workaround to registration concerns, but examples contain Authorization: Bearer undefined; live auth, terms, response replay and conversion remain unverified. The PDF itself restricts copying/distribution without permission, so it is linked, not copied.

documents.title: Normattiva updated-acts API endpoint
documents.verification_status: Endpoint and parameters are documented in the official API specification; direct access was not available through the research browser.
documents.version_evidence: Specification describes bounded start/end dates and returns identifiers and last-modification data; max 12 months and 7,000 acts per request.
documents.note: Research-client limitation does not prove publisher failure. Direct live response, authentication, pagination, terms and repeated-window behavior need verification.
